mapper.select: SELECT order_id AS orderId, order_status AS orderStatus, fulfillment_mode AS fulfillmentMode, pay_amount AS payAmount, ticket_issued_time AS ticketIssuedTime FROM ticket_order WHERE order_id = #{orderId} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM electronic_ticket WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND ticket_status = 'GENERATING'
mapper.update: UPDATE electronic_ticket SET ticket_status = 'UNUSED', qr_code_value = CONCAT('MAIMAI_QR_', ticket_no, '_', DATE_FORMAT(#{issueTime}, '%Y%m%d%H%i%s')), generate_time = #{issueTime}, abnormal_reason = NULL, update_time = #{issueTime} WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND ticket_status = 'GENERATING'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM electronic_ticket WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND ticket_status IN ('GENERATING', 'ERROR')
mapper.update: UPDATE electronic_ticket SET ticket_status = 'EXPIRED', qr_code_value = NULL, expire_time = #{expireTime}, abnormal_reason = #{abnormalReason}, update_time = #{expireTime} WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND ticket_status IN ('GENERATING', 'ERROR')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO refund_record (refund_no, order_id, refund_rule_id, matched_stage_id, refund_type_snapshot, fee_rate_snapshot, apply_time, reason, refund_amount, fee_amount, refund_status, refund_time, fail_reason, update_time) VALUES (#{refundNo}, #{orderId}, NULL, NULL, #{refundTypeSnapshot}, NULL, #{applyTime}, #{reason}, #{refundAmount}, #{feeAmount}, #{refundStatus}, #{refundTime}, NULL, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT ticket_id AS ticketId, order_id AS orderId, ticket_status AS ticketStatus FROM electronic_ticket WHERE ticket_id = #{ticketId} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE electronic_ticket SET ticket_status = 'CHECKED', check_time = #{checkTime}, update_time = #{checkTime} WHERE ticket_id = #{ticketId} AND ticket_status = 'UNUSED'

UPDATE ticket_order o SET o.order_status = 'FINISHED', o.finish_time = #{finishTime}, o.update_time = #{finishTime} WHERE o.order_id = #{orderId} AND o.order_status = 'WAIT_USE' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM electronic_ticket t WHERE t.order_id = o.order_id ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM electronic_ticket t WHERE t.order_id = o.order_id AND t.ticket_status <> 'CHECKED' )
